title: featureEdges
body:
## featureEdges

Extracts edges of a polygonal surface as line cells (polydata): boundary edges (used by one polygon), feature edges (between two polygons whose normals differ by more than angle), non-manifold edges (shared by three or more polygons) and optionally manifold edges. With the Schemaxis defaults (boundary, feature and non-manifold on, manifold off, 30°) it outlines a CAD or CFD surface's creases, open boundaries and T-junctions. Input must be polydata; run surface first on volume meshes. Use edges for every cell edge.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Feature detection uses polygon normals, so inconsistently oriented polygons create spurious feature edges; run normals with consistency first.
- Unmerged duplicate points make every polygon edge a boundary edge; run clean first.

Native constructor: `FeatureEdges`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Feature Edges filter. Accepted data: polygonal data (surfaces, lines or vertices) (vtkPolyData). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPolyData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `boundary` | If the value of this property is set to 1, boundary edges will be extracted. Boundary edges are defined as lines cells or edges that are used by only one polygon. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `true` | `true` |
| `feature` | If the value of this property is set to 1, feature edges will be extracted. Feature edges are defined as edges that are used by two polygons whose dihedral angle is greater than the feature angle. (See the FeatureAngle property.) Toggle whether to extract feature edges. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `true` | `true` |
| `manifold` | If the value of this property is set to 1, manifold edges will be extracted. Manifold edges are defined as edges that are used by exactly two polygons. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `false` | `false` |
| `nonManifold` | If the value of this property is set to 1, non-manifold edges will be extracted. Non-manifold edges are defined as edges that are use by three or more polygons. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `true` | `true` |
| `angle` | The value of this property is used to define a feature edge. If the surface normal between two adjacent triangles is at least as large as this Feature Angle, a feature edge exists. (See the FeatureEdges property.) | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":180}` | `30` | `30` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "featureEdges",
  "inputs": {
    "input": "UPSTREAM_input"
  }
}
```
